# SameBoy 1.0.5's Game Boy Color (its CGB-E model, through its own open boot ROM) running
# gb_test.cpp's cgb_stat_probe_rom() at single speed: 2400 bytes, the ROM's reads of STAT and LY
# in the order it makes them, 16 a row, read from its cartridge RAM (the rig's sameboy-frames
# --sav-out). Sections: A, rows 1-30, the LCD's start with LYC 0, 1, 2; B, rows 31-70, STAT
# interrupts seen from HALT, then by dispatch; C, rows 71-120, the end of VBlank (STAT, then LY);
# D, rows 121-150, line 153 (STAT, then LY). Regenerate only from SameBoy, never from the core.
